  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: To prepare one liter of final medium, suspend the amount of dehydrated
    powder indicated under FORMULAE-Solution (and on the package label) in 900 ml
    distilled and deionized water containing 2 ml glycerol and heat to boiling to
    dissolve completely. Sterilize in the autoclave for 10 or 15 min at 15 Ibs pressure
    (121°C), per label copy. Cool to 50-55°C.
- step_number: 3
  action: MIX
  description: Aseptically add 100 ml of the appropriate ADC Enrichment and mix throughly.
